routing.reason: This task updates execution-surface routing only; it must not cross the current human review gate or generate prose.

objective: Make Chat + EXTREME_HIGH the canonical default execution surface for the novel project while preserving all V3 content/phase routing and the current human review gate. Work becomes an exception only when materially better for long autonomous multi-app workflows; Codex remains the local-engineering route.

chat_covers: ordinary web search and source reading
normal repository/connector reads and small canonical writes when no local runtime is required
work_only_when: workflow is unusually long and autonomous
multiple apps/sites must be coordinated over many steps
Chat would be materially slower, fragmented, or unstable
a required capability is genuinely Work-only
codex_local_when: full local repository access is required
shell/python/tests/dependency installation/build/bulk file processing are required

Explicitly state ordinary web/browser work does not imply Work.
Explicitly state every newly opened Chat execution uses EXTREME_HIGH thinking.
Create one reusable routing policy artifact and one regression receipt.
Update README only if needed for user-facing consistency; do not alter story method content.

regression_cases.case: story diagnosis/rewrite or ordinary web/source check
current RJ-OE408-B human review preparation/card handling
local script validation, ingest pipeline execution, full-repo tests/build

success_condition: The novel project's canonical agent entrypoint makes Chat + EXTREME_HIGH the default execution surface, Work an exception only when materially advantageous, Codex the local-engineering route, and the current RJ-OE408-B human gate remains untouched.
